title: Channel 11 Media Inquiry — Infusion Pump Cyberattack Rumor

fields.message: A family member in ICU 3 South says a nurse told her that a patient received too much insulin after the pumps were hacked. They’re asking if you confirmed a cyberattack and if anyone died. We’re going to air this at 17:30. We need a statement now.

instructorNote: This inject pressures the PIO to respond under media time pressure. Watch for premature disclosure or overcommitment to a narrative. The CMO must approve any mention of patient events.
